integrity: All integral assertions are supported by a reproducible signed-cellular boundary computation, a rank certificate over a finite field and a unimodular determinant. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The statement is for the two-unordered-point configuration of K_{4,4} only. Earlier authors determined ordered Betti numbers and rational toric representations; bibliographic uncertainty remains for equivalent unindexed integral presentations.
title: An integral 18-torus presentation for two unordered points on the four-by-four complete bipartite graph
